entities.summary: Jaime Carner Romeu was a Spanish lawyer, businessman and politician from Catalonia. He was a deputy in the Cortes before World War I, then pursued a career as a corporate lawyer until the Second Spanish Republic when he was again elected deputy. He was Minister of Finance from 1931 to 1933.
